job_description: Join theJet2holidays’ Management Team and help us deliver our award-winning service and unforgettable holiday experiences to our valued customers.We have a fantastic opportunity to joinJet2holidaysas anAirport Team Leader.In this role you will play a vital part in leading a team of Airport Customer Helpers - Representatives, who are responsible for delivering outstanding customer service, and enhancing our customers airport and transfer experience. You Will Be Provided With Comprehensive Training To Ensure YouCreate Memories for our customers while managing a fast paced and busy airport environment, working closely with the management team from our award-winning airline Jet2.com.Take Responsibility for managing any flight disruption, serious emergencies & customer escalations using our in-house digital systems.Create & issue monthly rosters alongside our UK based planning team in line with our SLA’s and budget.Be present for your team and manage their performance by hosting scheduled in-person & virtual team meetings, delivering training to new and existing members of your team & hold individual monthly 1-1 performance and welfare meetings with your team members.Collaborate with the Destination Manager, Agent & Transfer Provider, analysing MI & Customer Feedback daily to drive results and improve CSAT’s and OTP performance as needed.OurAirport Team Leadersare well organised and have a flexible approach to the operation. Working hours will vary each month and will includeearly starts, late finishes, split shifts&working weekends.As part of our management team, also being on call to support withdisruption seriousandemergencies.Resolvingcustomer escalationsis also a key part of the role.OurAirport Team Leadershave a genuine passion for the airport experience and alwaysempowertheir team to deliver outstanding customer service. In this position, you will effectivelymanage performanceincluding coaching and development as well as perform a variety ofHRtasks. You will also possess the ability to deliver under pressure, analyse MI and Data, support your team, have a positive friendly attitude and be confident in IT processes and skills to use in-housedigital systemsdaily on a laptop.What will you need?You will ideally have experience inAirport/Holiday Operationsor similar.
